title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: Add turkey mince to a bowl.
Mix in egg, psyllium husk, soy sauce and seasonings until combined.
Let mixture rest 5 minutes.
Form into two wide patties.
Air fry at 190°C for 11–13 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Toast burger buns lightly if desired.
Place cooked patties on buns and serve.

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Steam vegetables until soft.
Mash vegetables in a bowl.
Add egg and breadcrumbs, season with salt and pepper.
Mix until a firm mixture forms.
Shape into patties.
Bake or air fry at 180°C for 12–15 minutes.
Toast burger buns lightly if desired.
Place patties on buns and serve.

title: Turkey Burger Wrap
instructions: Prepare turkey burger patties as above.
Air fry at 190°C for 11–13 minutes.
Warm whole grain wraps slightly if desired.
Place cooked patties on wraps.
Add lettuce, tomato and onion.
Wrap tightly and serve.

title: Veggie Burger Wrap
instructions: Prepare veggie burger mixture as above.
Shape into patties and bake or air fry until cooked.
Warm whole grain wraps slightly if desired.
Place patties on wraps.
Add lettuce, tomato and onion.
Wrap tightly and serve.

title: Creamy Mushroom & Spinach Whole Wheat Pasta
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Chop onion and garlic.
Slice mushrooms.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook onion until soft, about 3–4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add mushrooms and cook until browned.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Reduce heat and stir in skyr or yogurt.
Add a splash of reserved pasta water to loosen sauce if needed.
Drain pasta and combine with sauce.
Season with salt, pepper, and optional lemon juice to taste.
Serve immediately.
notes: A cheap, heart-friendly, vegetarian option perfect for a date night.

title: Heart-Healthy Banana Cocoa Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Mash bananas in a bowl.
Mix in eggs and olive oil.
Add oats, cocoa powder and baking powder.
Stir until smooth batter forms.
Pour into small baking tray.
Bake for 25–30 minutes.
notes: Slice and enjoy with banana or cocoa topping.

title: Banana Chocolate Oat Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Mash bananas in a bowl.
Add egg and mix well.
Stir in oats, cocoa and olive oil.
Pour batter into baking tray.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Allow to cool before slicing.

title: Fillet Steak with Potatoes
instructions: Season steak with salt and pepper.
Pan-fry or grill steak to preferred doneness.
Boil or roast potatoes until cooked.
Serve steak with potatoes.
Drizzle olive oil over potatoes.

title: Fillet Steak with Mushrooms
instructions: Cook steak and mushrooms to preferred doneness.
Boil or roast potatoes until cooked.
Serve steak and mushrooms with potatoes.
Drizzle olive oil on top.

title: Individual Beef Wellingtons
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Finely chop mushrooms, shallot, and garlic; sauté in olive oil until moisture evaporates and mixture is paste-like.
Season beef fillets with salt and pepper and sear in hot pan for 1–2 minutes per side.
Roll out puff pastry sheets; place mushroom mixture on pastry.
Place seared beef fillet on top and wrap pastry around to enclose completely.
Brush pastry with beaten egg.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until pastry is golden and beef is cooked to preferred doneness.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
notes: Perfect individual Beef Wellingtons for a special occasion.
